items.title: Jackson Gutierrez and Hunter Gennicks Named NAAA Co-Athletes of the Week Presented by USAA
items.summary: ANNAPOLIS, Md. — Navy junior quarterback Jackson Gutierrez and senior sprint football running back Hunter Gennicks have been named the Naval Academy Athletic Association Co-Athletes of the Week presented by USAA following their outstanding performances in victories over No. 24 Memphis and Army in the CSFL Championship Game, respectively.

items.title: Navy Closes Out American Conference Action Saturday at Charlotte
items.summary: Navy (4-6, 3-4 American Conference) and Charlotte (1-10, 1-6) will meet on the gridiron for the third time in series history when the two square off on ESPN+ on Saturday (12 noon) at Jerry Richardson Stadium (15,314) in Charlotte.
